subject: Next steps — 30-minute product preview and stakeholder alignment (Heliox)
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliox.ai>, Tom Park <tom.park@heliox.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — 30-minute product preview and stakeholder alignment (Heliox)

Hi Elena and Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Heliox's ingest volume and the latency targets for inference in your control plane. Quick recap and a proposed next step: we recommend a focused 30-minute product preview where we'll show the Redwood inference runtime, routing options for multi-region fallbacks, and a short ops checklist for Dedicated/Private deployment patterns.

Who should attend from your side? From ours I'll bring Neha (solutions engineer) and myself. If you have an infra or security lead who wants to join we can surface the Dedicated/private controls in the latter half of the session.

Proposed 30-min windows (all in PDT) — pick one or suggest alternatives:
- Tue Sep 9, 10:00–10:30am
- Wed Sep 10, 2:30–3:00pm
- Thu Sep 11, 11:00–11:30am

Please confirm which slot works and list the attendees you plan to include. I attached a short prep checklist and the security worksheet you asked about — no need to fill everything, just the high-level items.

Next steps on our side if you confirm a time: we'll send a calendar invite with an agenda, a shared Doc (pooled prep notes), and a brief pre-read tailored to the areas you highlighted today (KV cache & model variants).

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0127

Attachments: heliox-security-worksheet.pdf (PDF, 380KB), 30m-demo-prep-checklist.md (text)

Subject: Re: Next steps — 30-minute product preview and stakeholder alignment (Heliox)

Thanks, Avery — great talk yesterday.

Wed Sep 10, 2:30–3:00pm PDT works for us. Attendees: Elena Soto (data platform), Tom Park (infrastructure), and I can try to loop in Priya (security) — will confirm by EOD Monday if she can join.

Can you include a short bullet agenda in the invite so we can route internally? Also +1 to seeing the security worksheet before the call.

Appreciate it — see you next week.

Best,
Elena
